page.overview:
What is Minor Animatronics?

This is a list of minor animatronics and bots from the Fazbear Frights series. They have a very small role in the series.

This monkey-shaped robot is created by Ms. Billings and was designed to crash its cymbals to quiet the class, although can be only controlled with a remote. Its design description may be based on the cymbal-banging monkey toy.

A spider-shaped endoskeleton is created by Mrs. Billings. It was capable of attaching stickers to keep track of participation.

The robot is created by Mrs. Billings. It was modeled after the horse and gallops around the classroom to demonstrate an engine.
